description:
Do Ha-Neul is an ordinary college student living a bright and carefree life. Her only complex is that she has difficulty making choices due to the trauma of her parents’ divorce. One day, when she was bored and ordinary, she meets a famous art student, Kang Seon-Han, who is famous for being handsome… “Don’t you remember me?” Kang Seon-Han approaches her suspiciously as if they know each other, and while she gets entangled with him, her first love Seo Hae-Yang comes to visit her, and somehow she ends up living with her first love in the same house. Kang Seon-Han, whose future is certain, and Seo Hae-Yang, who unwaveringly follows her own path. The two people are strangely similar. “I like you.” The same confession from the two people who look similar. “Think about it carefully. You like me too, right?” Both of them are sure that Ha-Neul likes them. Who do I really like? I like them both so much. But there is only one choice. You or you. At the moment of choice that comes, they realize true love.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
